title: 第1472章 待改5第1470章 待改4
slug: 投资天命族人我实力是全族总和
content_zh:
更夸张的是，他们并非出自不同势力，是全部来自同一个家族。
“我族若能出一位这样的天骄，老夫做梦都能笑醒。”
一位白发老者看着擂台上的身影，语气中满是羡慕。
另一人闻言，不禁叹道：“在外界足以被当作一族希望的天骄，到了这苍梧姜家，却一次出现七个。”
“这还只是如今的小辈，再往前，还有少帝那样更加夸张的存在.......”
说到这里，现场众人不约而同沉默下来。
人比人，的确没有意义。
他们所渴望的绝世天骄，在姜家根本不算稀缺。
前一批天骄尚未走到巅峰，新的天骄便已经开始崭露锋芒。
这等传承底蕴，放眼整个天墟，也难以找出第二个。
此刻。
演武场最上方的一处席位中。
姜辰望着擂台上交错的身影，眼中不由浮现出几分感慨。
“看着他们，倒让我想起了当年第一次七脉大比。”
姜昊笑了起来。
“那时候大家的修为都不算高，打起来却一个比一个拼命，最后还不是让辰哥你拿了第一。”
姜炎靠在座椅上，淡淡一笑。
“辰哥能拿到第一，那不是理所当然的事情？”
说着，他看向其余众人。
“说起来，你们平时一个个都藏挺深，真打起来才发现，手段多到根本用不完。”

姜辰无奈摇头。
“都过去多少年了，还提这些做什么。”
他目光重新落向两座擂台。
“如今，北冥这小子的剑道已经初具自己的气象，再继续走下去，不必完全拘泥于功法本身。”
姜芷微微微颔首。
她本就是剑修，对姜北冥的剑道感受最深。
“北冥的剑意很强，可出剑之时仍留有几分刻意，等到剑随心动，不假思索，才算真正走出自己的路。”
听到她的评价，众人并不意外。
放眼如今的姜家，若论剑道，姜芷微无疑最有资格开口。
姜辰又看向另一座擂台。
“姜奇的力量足够强，神通也十分霸道，只是他太过依赖正面压制，一旦遇到真正不惧力量，或者境界远高于他的对手，便容易陷入被动。”
姜北野忍不住瞥了姜昊一眼。
旋即调侃道：“年轻人嘛，拳头够硬的时候，总喜欢先打上一拳再说。”
“等以后吃几次亏，自然就知道变通了。”
姜寒的目光则落在姜囡囡身上。
content_en:
What's even more exaggerated is that they are not from different forces, but all from the same family.
"If our clan could produce such a talented person, I would be able to laugh out of my dreams."
A white-haired old man looked at the figure on the ring, his tone full of envy.
When another person heard this, he couldn't help but sigh: "In the outside world, there are seven talented people who are regarded as the hope of the clan, but when they arrive at the Cangwu Jiang family, seven of them appear at once."
"This is just the junior generation today. Going forward, there will be even more exaggerated existences like the Young Emperor..."
At this point, everyone at the scene fell silent.
Comparing people to others is indeed meaningless.
The peerless talents they longed for were not scarce at all in the Jiang family.
The previous batch of geniuses have not yet reached their peak, but the new geniuses have already begun to show their talents.
Looking at the entire Tianxu, it would be difficult to find another one with this level of inheritance.
now.
In the seat at the top of the martial arts arena.
Jiang Chen looked at the intertwining figures on the ring, and couldn't help but feel a bit of emotion in his eyes.
"Looking at them, it reminds me of the first Seven Meridian Competition that year."
Jiang Hao laughed.
"At that time, everyone's cultivation level was not very high, but they fought harder than the other, and in the end, Brother Chen, you won the first place."
Jiang Yan leaned on the seat and smiled lightly.
"Brother Chen can get first place, isn't that a matter of course?"
As he spoke, he looked at the rest of the people.
"Speaking of which, you usually hide your secrets pretty well, but when we get into a fight, you realize that you have so many methods that you can't even use them all."
Jiang Chen shook his head helplessly.
"It's been so many years, why are you still mentioning this?"
His eyes returned to the two arenas.
"Now, Bei Ming's swordsmanship has begun to take shape. If he continues, he doesn't have to stick to the technique itself."
Jiang Zhi nodded slightly.
She is a swordsman by nature and has the deepest experience with Jiang Beiming's swordsmanship.
"Beiming's sword intention is very strong, but he still has a certain degree of deliberateness when he draws the sword. Only when the sword moves according to his heart, without thinking, can he truly find his own way."
Everyone was not surprised to hear her comments.
Looking at the current Jiang family, when it comes to swordsmanship, Jiang Zhiwei is undoubtedly the most qualified to speak.
Jiang Chen looked at another arena.
"Jiang Qi's power is strong enough, and his magical powers are also very domineering, but he relies too much on frontal suppression. Once he encounters an opponent who is truly not afraid of power, or whose realm is much higher than his, he will easily fall into passivity."
Jiang Beiye couldn't help but glance at Jiang Hao.
He immediately joked: "Young people, when your fists are hard enough, you always like to punch them first."
"After you suffer a few losses in the future, you will naturally learn to adapt."
Jiang Han's eyes fell on Jiang Nannan.
